subject: That shard you found
body:
You found a gem shard in a geode, didn't you? There's a whole craft built around these, colors you can mix, and things you can build out of color.

I've started a section of the book on it. Start with a Pedestal and I'll add pages as you go. This is what it looks like built. @archive:integrated_boogaloo:pastel_pedestal @display:integrated_boogaloo:guide/pedestal_build

Your old friend,
Dr. T
